findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_listing_details, get_owner_listing_checklist, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, search_services, quote_service_booking · Private data: fetch, search_listings, get_listing_details, compare_listings, get_development_transactions, get_development_price_summaries, get_monthly_price_report, get_price_trend, get_rental_yield, render_listing_detail, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, search_services, prepare_guest_service_checkout, get_guest_service_checkout_status · Public sink: search_guides, search_agents, search_services, quote_service_booking, prepare_guest_service_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search, fetch, get_listing_details, get_owner_listing_checklist, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, search_services, quote_service_booking · Private data: fetch, search_listings, get_listing_details, compare_listings, get_development_transactions, get_development_price_summaries, get_monthly_price_report, get_price_trend, get_rental_yield, render_listing_detail, search_guides, search_agents, check_landed_purchase_eligibility, search_services, prepare_guest_service_checkout, get_guest_service_checkout_status · Public sink: search_guides, search_agents, search_services, quote_service_booking, prepare_guest_service_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_services" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

Each result carries the provider, package, catalogue version, and price required for quoting and checkout. Prices shown are before Homejourney's booking fee. Each booking adds one booking fee: S$4.90 on Homejourney's standard prices, or only the card-pro"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
